caribbean.headline: Roatan Sees Rain and Choppy ENE Seas
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing ENE-dominant swell with 4.3 ft wave heights, sustained winds near 18 kt, and 75% rain probability. I expect choppy harbor approaches with brief heavy showers reducing visibility through the day; St. Lucia is the runner-up with lighter 10 kt winds but should monitor the same 7 s ENE swell.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos 21 kt Winds and 5.4 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing north winds up to 21 kt with seas to 5.4 ft, a dominant N swell at a 7 s period, and less than 10% rain probability. I recommend caution for small boats and tender operations around Mykonos while Lisbon remains much lighter with winds near 11 kt.
